label: 桥梁端头标记
description: 给桥掩码逐格打「端头 / 普通」标签，端头再分横向长条（竖向桥的上下端）与竖向长条（横向桥的左右端）。桥梁 autotile 的端头收口块与桥身扶手块八邻域完全同形，纯邻域查表不可分，必须由上游打标；tagGrid 接 grid2node 的 stateGrid、stateValues 接同名口，体素即带上 state.bridgeTag，rule 用 face.variants 的 when.stateEquals 分派 map。输入/输出都是单张 grid（item），网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
description-en: Tags each cell of a bridge mask as end-cap or body; end-caps are further split into horizontal strips (caps of a vertically-running bridge) and vertical strips (caps of a horizontally-running bridge). Bridge autotile end-caps and rail tiles share an identical 8-neighbourhood, so the distinction must come from an upstream tag. Wire tagGrid into grid2node's stateGrid and stateValues into its namesake port; the rule then dispatches via face.variants when.stateEquals.
icon: 俯视一条灰色桥带，两端各有一小段高亮的收口条，扁平插画风格，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 桥掩码
inputs.description: 单张二维网格（grid[y][x]）；非零值为桥格。可直接接 river_bridge 的 outputGrid。
inputs.description-en: A single 2D grid (grid[y][x]); non-zero cells are bridge cells. Feed river_bridge's outputGrid directly.

inputs.name: thickness
inputs.label: 桥宽（格）
inputs.description: 桥的厚度（垂直于走向的格数）。端头长条的长度必须 ≤ 该值才算端头——这条也是 L 拐角的防线：拐角外侧那一列虽然一侧全空，但长度等于桥臂长度，会被挡掉。
inputs.description-en: Bridge thickness in cells (across its running direction). A terminal strip counts as an end-cap only when its length is at most this value; this is also what keeps L-bend outer columns from being mistaken for caps.

outputs.name: tagGrid
outputs.label: 标签网格
outputs.description: 与输入同尺寸；0=普通桥身，1=端头·横向长条，2=端头·竖向长条。接 grid2node 的 stateGrid。
outputs.description-en: Same size as the input; 0 = body, 1 = end-cap horizontal strip, 2 = end-cap vertical strip. Wire into grid2node's stateGrid.

outputs.name: stateValues
outputs.label: 标签取值表
outputs.description: ["", "entry_h", "entry_v"]，接 grid2node 的 stateValues，把 tagGrid 的数值翻成 rule 认识的标签字符串。
outputs.description-en: ["", "entry_h", "entry_v"] — wire into grid2node's stateValues to translate tagGrid numbers into the tag strings the rule matches on.

outputs.name: entryCount
outputs.label: 端头格数
outputs.description: 被标记为端头的格子数量（0 通常意味着 thickness 与实际桥宽不符）。
outputs.description-en: Number of cells tagged as end-caps (0 usually means thickness does not match the actual bridge width).
